question: Related Questions Q. After hajj, we went to masjid ayesha for jiyaarah only and did not intended to perform Umra. We performed Two rakat namaj and came back . Alhamdulillah as I intended to do Umrah, I completed my Umrah and did another umrah from Masjid - e- Aisha. I then went next day to Medina to visit Masjid e Nabuwi and on returning I did not intend to do Umrah again and returned from Medina to Makaah without Ihram. Have I committed a mistake? and if yes what should I do as now I am back in Bombay. Please advice urgently. 4118 views Q. Umrah 4831 views Q. My age is 44 yesrs & I have not done my Haj so far but,intended to do in the near future with wife.I want to do Haj-e-badal for my late grand father who died without doing his own Haj. I have been under debt,the loan has been taken from Individuals as well as Bank to fulfill various needs including house constuction.My wife is pregnent & she can't go for Haj this year.Two daughters are very small-6 & 3 yrs old respectively. The expense of late grand father's Haj-e-badal has to be born by my parents,who are also going for their Haj this year. Now my question is :- Taking into above facts & circumstances,Can I do the Haj-e-badal for my late grand father without doing my own Haj? 1823 views Q. We are going for Umrah in Ramadan, in-shaAllah and would like to ask you two questions 2374 views Q. One of my friends tells me that doing an umrah by wearing ahram from "masjid-e-Aisha" is permissible only for women folk and not for men. His explanation was that Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh) asked aisha(radiallahu anha) to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha" as she was sick during the time of Hajj, and her brother was not asked to do the same when he accompanied her. If this was permissible for men then Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh)would have also asked him to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha". My friend also tells me that according to Imam Abu Hanifa Rahmatulla alayh, such umrah is permissible for men but is makruh. Please quote to the exact hadith in discussion and explanation as to how and why it is permissible for men and also comment on the views of my friend. Jazakallahukhaira. 4361 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 36166 Country: India Title: I usually read your website and your Fatwas. I have one problem, please tell me the solution Question: I usually read your website and your Fatwas. I have one problem, please tell me the solution. I am currently staying at Abha (kingdom of Saudi Arabia), it is located 700 Km from Mecca. I shaved my head on Eid al-Azha (7/11/2011), last Wednesday (7/12/2011) I visited Mecca to perform umrah. I performed first umrah on Thursday at 4:00 am, then after performing my umrah I cut my hair 4 or 5 places around the head, (this day I met with one of the Jordanian, he suggest this idea and he performed in the same way. Then next umrah I performed on Friday 11 am, then I cut my hair 4 or 5 places around the head, (this day I thought to remove hair completely but I could not find time, my bus was waiting for me to leave Abha. When I discussed this issue with my friends they said "dam is wajib on you" so kindly do Qurbani for two animals in the Haram. Could you suggest the best way? Answer ID: 36166 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 368/205/H=1433) Your shaved your head on 07/11/2011 and performed umrah after one month. Since, usually the hair do not grow in one month to a length that they reach equal to the tip of finger or more. So if the hair of head are too short to be cut equal to indicator finger then in such case in order to become halal from ihram it is not enough only to cut the hair of head, rather it is wajib to shave it. So, you performed umrah on 07/12/2011 and cut your hair from four or five places. You should know that cutting hair in this way is makrooh. However, you were not halal from the ihram of umrah and the next day you made intention of ihram for another umrah. It was not right to become halal from the first ihram, then wearing the second ihram caused a dam (slaughtering of an animal) and in the second umrah you cut your hair like before then also it was also not right to become halal from this ihram too. Thus this time too you remained in the state of ihram. As soon as you receive this fatwa, shave the complete head or get it shaved and offer three dam (one for the jinayah of wearing ihram of second umrah without being halal from the first one, and the second one for going out of haram boundary without being halal from second umrah and third one due to wearing stitched clothes). You should slaughter these dams in the boundary of Haram. And if you committed any other jinayah between them like cutting nail, having intercourse etc then write it to us to know the Shariah rulings of the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
